info.title: AstroYuga API
info.description:
REST API for the AstroYuga astrology platform — users, astrologers, consultations (chat / call / video), wallet & payouts, kundli, predictions, academy, pujas and admin tooling.

Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Each operation carries a 🔒 Access line stating the role(s) it needs. Use **Authorize** to paste a token and try requests live — pick the matching server first.

type.description: Purpose of the OTP. Defaults to LOGIN.

phoneNumber.description: 10-digit Indian mobile number (no +91 / no leading 0). Must match the number used in send-otp.

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP delivered to the phone by send-otp.

role.description: Optional — pin the verification to a specific role so a USER and ASTROLOGER sharing the same phone resolve to distinct accounts.

notificationMuteFrom.description: HH:MM 24-hour or empty string to clear.

continuesFromOrderId.description: Reference to the previous order being "continued from" — must belong to user

birthProfileId.description:
Birth profile this consultation is for (Astrotalk-style picker).
Backend snapshots the profile fields onto the order at create time.

promoCode.description: Optional promo code applied at recharge time. Bonus is credited after payment capture.

planet.description: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu (+ outer planets if used)

yudhKey.description: Key linking this rule to UddhoshResult.yudhKey

timing.description: Optional timing window (e.g. "during Saturn dasha" or "after age 30")

childrenNames.description: CSV of children names — kept simple, frontend joins from chips.

courseId.description: Optional course this class belongs to. Empty = standalone class.

categories.description: Optional AstroTalk-style per-area readings; null falls back to prediction.

isPremium.description: Premium entries show only to subscribers; free (default) show to everyone.

isAutoGenerated.description: True when produced by the Vedic generator (admin edits flip this off).

notificationMuteFrom.description:
Do-not-disturb window as HH:MM (24-hour). Both must be set for muting to
apply. Wraps across midnight when `to < from` (e.g. 22:00–07:00).

title.description: Short label shown to astrologers, e.g. "Strong career growth".

category.description: Life area: career | marriage | health | wealth | education | general.

remedy.description: Optional remedy advice for this prediction.

conditions.description: Array of PredictionCondition — ALL must match for a 100% hit.

priority.description: Higher priority predictions surface first when multiple match.

createdBy.description: Admin user id who authored this prediction.

researchNoteId.description: The saved kundali (research note) this remedy is recommended for.

problemLinkedDosha.description: Optional link to a detected dosha by name (KundliDosha.name).

remedyProductId.description: Optional link to an existing catalog product (remedy_products).

targetPlanet.description: The graha the remedy acts on — drives the effect calculation.
